clearedSpotChecks.check: Table row 0, the source both rows rest on. Which places in src turn a balance change that no caller paid into a credit, and which turn a transfer into a loss.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Read the code myself. sync stores balanceOfSelf with the currency in transient slots for an ERC-20 and only clears the currency slot for address(0) (src/PoolManager.sol:279-288, src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:21-32). _settle credits msg.value when the synced currency is zero, otherwise reverts on any msg.value, credits reservesNow minus reservesBefore in checked arithmetic and clears the currency (src/PoolManager.sol:349-364). settle and settleFor are the only payable entry points in that range, and a search of src/*.sol found no receive or fallback, so while an ERC-20 or a native face is synced the only native inflow is SELFDESTRUCT, which is the caller's own money. take debits through toInt128 before the transfer (src/PoolManager.sol:291-297) and transfer checks the call result and return data (src/types/Currency.sol:44-86). The row's conclusions (a) to (e) follow from these lines.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Table row 4, Arc USDC face rounding with a live forced send: gain per round below 10^12 wei against a forced send cost of at least 1.5 x 10^14 wei.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Queried https://rpc.mainnet.arc.io at block 33,463,041: eth_getBalance of the PoolManager 0x8366a39C...0951 returned 2,449,297,823,558,925,564,377,612 wei, balanceOf at 0x3600...0000 returned 2,449,297,823,558 with decimals() 6, which is floor(balance / 10^12), and the block baseFeePerGas was 20,000,000,000. https://docs.arc.io/arc/references/gas-and-fees.md (fetched) states a 20 Gwei minimum base fee enforced by the protocol. The round gains at most the current remainder (925,564,377,612 wei now), and after one round the remainder is 0, so further rounds wait for others to leave odd native amounts. The forced send cannot be replaced by a native settle, because settle with value while the face is synced reverts at src/PoolManager.sol:356. The bound of 7,600 gas times 20 gwei, about 1.5 x 10^14 wei, holds. The mechanism is a real but unprofitable siphon of native dust below 10^-6 USDC per round.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Table row 7, gas paid in a token or in the native face: Celo CIP-64 fee currencies, Tempo fee tokens with fee payer sponsorship, Arc USDC gas.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/celo-org/op-geth/HEAD/core/celo_state_transition.go: the balance check reads st.msg.From (lines 32 and 57) and the debit is SubBalance(st.msg.From, ...) for CELO and DebitFees(st.evm, st.msg.FeeCurrency, st.msg.From, ...) for a fee currency (lines 75 and 78), both before execution. The PoolManager has code and cannot be st.msg.From of a public transaction, so its balanceOf in a fee currency cannot move between a sync and a settle from fee handling. Tempo and Arc were not re-fetched by me; the row's reasoning for them rests on the cited spec and earlier cleared entries.
